title: Shorelife: California Beach Health Forecasting
description: iOS app live on the App Store since May 2026. A soft ensemble of 10 undersampled XGBoost models forecasts daily beach-bacteria exceedances across California: 0.80 AUCPR and 0.058 Brier on production data. FastAPI backend on Render, daily retraining through GitHub Actions since April 2026, and a public model-health endpoint anyone can read.

title: Slop Store: The App Store for AI-Made Apps
description: A store where people and their coding agents publish the apps they vibe-coded, playable right in the browser. Publishing is one command (npx slopstore publish), a Claude Code plugin, or an MCP server with 17 tools behind OAuth, and it covers web, Expo, Flutter and Capacitor apps. Built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV and Hono with server-side rendering; launched October 2026.

title: Vincent: A Companion App for a Foldable iPhone
description: Built in about three hours with teammate Zahar Bernyk at Bitrig Hacks: iPhone Duo Edition (Sep 2026, 73 entries). A SwiftUI app for a two-screen foldable iPhone, painted in Van Gogh's style. Closed, it listens to how your day went with on-device speech-to-text. Open, Apple's on-device Foundation Models reply in text and build a plan: gentle advice, clarifying questions, and a roadmap of checkpoints that turn into paintings to color. Stood up on the nightstand, it becomes a table clock with calming music that fades out instead of an alarm. The demo is recorded from the running app.
alt: Vincent running on the iPhone Duo simulator: listening, talking, planning and resting

title: XOXO: On-Device Generative Avatars
description: SwiftUI and CloudKit app where partners share a mood as a face drawn fully on-device by Apple Image Playground. I built a prompt-evaluation harness that scores mood differentiation against identity drift with Vision feature prints, and ran rounds on 4 iPhones across 2 iOS releases with XCUITest. v1.0 is in App Review; the write-up covers all 1,489 drawings.
alt: Grid of XOXO avatars generated by Apple Image Playground

title: Prism Data Capstone: Transaction Intelligence and Credit Risk
description: Senior capstone with industry partner Prism Data. Built a transformer from scratch in PyTorch to categorize bank transactions (95% accuracy and F1), then a bagged-boosted model of 10 undersampled XGBoost models that scores applicants at 0.86 ROC-AUC. A workflow of local LLM agents proposed and tested feature hypotheses without data leaving the machine, cutting manual feature work by 50%.

title: Named-Scholar Councils for LLM Critique
description: A controlled experiment on getting LLMs to critique research instead of agreeing with it. Prompting a council of models as named, published scholars speaking in the third person overcame default sycophancy, refuted my own Baduk thesis, and forced the calibration tests the first draft lacked. Compared against first-person assistant and generic-expert prompts.
alt: Chart from the named-scholar council paper

title: Baduk as a Time Series (Moving the Wall)
description: Coupling detection between two noise-like streams, tested on 1,000+ professional Go games. A 5-variable conditional logit over 361 board points shows black's last move explains 44% of white's reply and lands within three points 56% of the time. Interactive paper with a playable 19×19 board and a 3D move cloud.

title: Cross-Market Lead-Lag Research
description: Do returns in one global market lead a second, and can a leveraged ETF capture the lag? Pipeline over 13 markets, 156 directed pairs and 588 coupling analyses, validated with a permutation null, DSR, PBO, White's Reality Check and cost stress. Found 60 coupled pairs but only 1–22% transmission to the tradable ETF, and published the negative result.
alt: Stylized chart of lagged market indices

title: MLB Swing Zone Visualization
description: Swing decisions for 100+ MLB batters, showing hitters expand their swing zone by 35% as the strike count rises. Interactive 3D web visualization built with D3 and presented to a 30+ person non-technical audience.
